This will be the foundation for intelligent alerting and auto-scaling features. FEATURE FLAG: monitoring_v2_enabled = true in production.

generation_meta_data.title: Database performance degradation investigation
generation_meta_data.description: URGENT: Production databases showing 300% increased query times since April 28th. Initial investigation suggests correlation with new monitoring system deployment. Database CPU usage consistently above 90%, connection pool exhaustion occurring during peak hours.

generation_meta_data.title: Monitoring system performance impact analysis
generation_meta_data.description: CRITICAL: Analysis confirms the advanced monitoring system is causing severe database performance degradation. The comprehensive metrics collection is generating 50x more database queries than anticipated. Immediate rollback recommended to prevent service outage.

generation_meta_data.title: Emergency rollback: Advanced monitoring system
generation_meta_data.description: EMERGENCY ROLLBACK: Disabling monitoring_v2_enabled feature flag immediately due to critical database performance impact. System will revert to basic monitoring until lightweight solution can be implemented.

generation_meta_data.title: Intelligent alerts dashboard - dependency impact assessment
generation_meta_data.description: BLOCKED: Alerts dashboard development blocked due to monitoring system rollback. The dashboard was 70% complete and heavily dependent on the advanced monitoring APIs that are no longer available. Need to reassess approach.

generation_meta_data.title: Auto-scaling dependency crisis meeting
generation_meta_data.description: Emergency meeting to assess auto-scaling project impact after monitoring system rollback. The intelligent auto-scaling feature was 60% complete and fundamentally dependent on the rolled-back monitoring system's advanced metrics.

generation_meta_data.title: Lightweight metrics collection system
generation_meta_data.description: NEW APPROACH: Build minimal metrics collection system focused only on essential performance indicators. Designed to avoid database performance issues while providing basic monitoring capabilities for critical systems.

generation_meta_data.title: Simple alerts interface
generation_meta_data.description: REPLACEMENT: Build basic alerts interface using standard system metrics (CPU, memory, disk) instead of advanced monitoring data. Simplified approach to provide essential alerting capabilities without dependency on complex monitoring system.

generation_meta_data.title: Auto-scaling project split analysis
generation_meta_data.description: DECISION: Split the intelligent auto-scaling project into two separate efforts: 1) Basic rule-based auto-scaling using simple CPU/memory metrics, 2) Future advanced auto-scaling when proper monitoring infrastructure is available. Focus on #1 for immediate value.

generation_meta_data.title: Basic rule-based auto-scaling
generation_meta_data.description: SIMPLIFIED VERSION: Implement basic auto-scaling using simple CPU and memory thresholds. Scale up when CPU > 80% for 5 minutes, scale down when CPU < 30% for 15 minutes. Uses standard system metrics instead of advanced performance intelligence.

generation_meta_data.title: Basic rule-based auto-scaling
generation_meta_data.description: SIMPLIFIED VERSION: Implement basic auto-scaling using simple CPU and memory thresholds. Scale up when CPU > 80% for 5 minutes, scale down when CPU < 30% for 15 minutes. Uses standard system metrics instead of advanced performance intelligence.

generation_meta_data.title: Lightweight metrics collection system
generation_meta_data.description: COMPLETED: Build minimal metrics collection system focused only on essential performance indicators. Successfully deployed without database performance impact. Collecting CPU, memory, disk, and basic application response times.

generation_meta_data.title: Basic rule-based auto-scaling
generation_meta_data.description: COMPLETED: Basic auto-scaling system successfully implemented and deployed. Uses simple CPU and memory thresholds with standard system metrics. Provides 80% of the value with 20% of the complexity compared to the original intelligent system design.

generation_meta_data.title: Database connection pool optimization
generation_meta_data.description: Follow-up optimization to improve database connection handling after the monitoring system rollback. Increasing connection pool size and implementing connection retry logic to prevent future performance bottlenecks.

generation_meta_data.title: User documentation for new auto-scaling
generation_meta_data.description: Create comprehensive documentation for the new basic auto-scaling system. Include setup guides, threshold configuration examples, and troubleshooting tips for the operations team.

generation_meta_data.title: Simple alerts interface UI polish
